body.p: Three women are going by boat, they have three bags of dried meat. A fox shouted: "Women, take me into the boat." They took it. While driving the fox said: "Seat me into the boat, cover [me]. Seeing mountains and rivers, I will tell the names of the river and the mountain while sleeping. It fell asleep. "Which river can be seen there?", they asked. "Bag strings, bag strings!" Driving, they asked: "Which river can be seen there?" "Bridle, bridle!" Then they still went on. "Fox, which river can be seen?" "[Of] lice, [of] lice! Land", it said, "I want to pee!" They landed, the fox went to pee. Peeing it laughed and shouted: "Hahaha, I have eaten up the whole dried meat." There the women started to chase him with sticks. The fox climbed up onto a tree. They lit it up. The fox said to the fire: "Don't eat [me] completely, let a sleeve's length behind." The fire let a sleeve's length behind. Since then the tail of the fox is [as long as] a sleeve.
